events.title: Books & Bricks Book Club for Grades 4-6

cases.refreshed: Join our book and Lego building club for fourth to sixth graders! This month we are reading the graphic novel Duel by Jessixa Bagley. We will meet on Monday, November 16th at 3:30 PM in the Program Room. Please read the book before our meeting. At the meeting we will discuss the book and do a Lego building activity. Special thanks to the Friends of Milpitas Library for making this program possible. For accessibility accommodations (e.g., ASL), please fill out the online form at sccld.org/accessibility 7+ days prior to the event. If you need assistance with the form, speak with a staff member at your local library, call (408) 540-3945, or email us at ask@lib.sccgov.org.

The Veena Duet concert will be presented by Hrishikesh Chary and Priyanka Chary accompanied by Shriram Brahmanandam on Mrudangam. The concert is an indoor event taking place in the Saratoga Community Room. All are welcome. Thanks to Friends of the Saratoga Libraries for sponsoring this program. cases.refreshed: Learn the basics of design in Tinkercad and see your creation come to life with our 3D printer! Participants will have the opportunity to create a project that will be printed out for pickup later. Recommended for ages 8+. Parents must supervise children under 8 and younger. Reminder: Laptops are available for only 8 participants. Participants are welcome to bring their own laptops.

events.title: Friends of the Almaden Library Fall Book Sale

cases.refreshed: Shop from a large collection of books and media for bargain prices at the Almaden Library Book Sale, hosted by the Friends of the Almaden Library. All proceeds go toward funding Almaden library books, activities and programs, plus accompanying supplies and materials. Come out to support your local library branch and find new literary treasures for yourself and your family.
